text:
Alex W: quick QA on a docs PR — updates dashboard cost/latency example and replaces tracehook snippet with new tracecontext API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Maria L: looking... what's the scope? only docs or sample code change too?
Alex W: both — we changed dashboard JSON keys (cost_per_token -> cost_per_unit) and swapped the tracehook example from old `attach_trace_id(req)` to new `tracecontext.inject(req)` to match SDK v2.
Ben R: heads up — runtime still emits trace header `x-rw-trace` in some paths. If docs show `traceparent` only, that'll confuse users.
Maria L: good catch. we should add note: "runtime may emit x-rw-trace for legacy agents" and include mapping snippet.
Maria L: proposed snippet:

```
# Python example (sdk v2)
from redwood import TraceContext
ctx = TraceContext.current()
headers = {}
ctx.inject(headers)
response = client.generate(..., headers=headers)
```

Sam I: also found broken link in the dashboard JSON example to the 'cost attribution' guide — 404. I'll drop a redirect in infra.
Docs Bot: PR #842 opened by alexw — labels: docs, obsv, needs-qa
Alex W: can someone volunteer to sanity-check the merged dashboard rendering? probably a quick look through Console with the new key names.
Ben R: i'll run a local Console build and point at the sample JSON. timeline: 1.5h
Maria L: I'll update the PR with the note about x-rw-trace + add a short migration blurb. Assigning to @Ben R for render check.
Alex W: perfect, thx. after Ben confirms, I'll merge and Sam can deploy the redirect.
Sam I: ack — will put redirect in next infra patch, ETA today EOD.
Maria L: also added a small test snippet to CI to check for broken external links in docs.
Alex W: awesome. checklist:
- Maria: add runtime note + migration blurb
- Ben: render check in Console
- Sam: infra redirect
- Alex: merge after checks

:thumbsup:
